description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Heavy Arbalest by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers twice.
Resolve the first Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
